description: This line plot illustrates the Micro F1 (%) scores for four different relation extraction datasets—TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval—as a function of the number of samples generated, with the x-axis labeled “Number of Samples Generated” and marked at K=16, K=32, and K=64. The y-axis is labeled “Micro F1 (%)” and ranges from 25% to 50% with tick marks at 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, and 50. The TACRED dataset is represented by a blue line with circular markers, starting at approximately 24% at K=16 and rising to about 43% at K=64. The TACRED-Revisit dataset is shown as an orange line with triangular markers, beginning near 24% at K=16 and increasing to approximately 43% at K=64. The Re-TACRED dataset is depicted by a green line with diamond markers, starting at about 35% at K=16, rising sharply to a peak of approximately 48% at K=32, then slightly declining to around 47% at K=64. The SemEval dataset is represented by a red line with star markers, beginning at roughly 42% at K=16, increasing steadily to approximately 48% at K=32, and reaching its highest point of about 51% at K=64. All lines show an overall increasing trend as the number of samples generated increases, with the SemEval dataset achieving the highest Micro F1 score across all sample counts.
